The film makes it more funny and more realistic when it comes to what would most people do if they died and woke up every day without a scratch.

It's fun but also cruel because after all, death is terrifying.

The film has a great cast and great writing and a heartwarming end that it could seam shocking and not reasonable, but after rewatching it, I get it.

The movie will live forever it's very rewatchable and Groundhog Day doesn't have any favor in it. I even think it's safe to say it's better.
This movie's premise is taken from groundhog day. However i like this take more than that movie. The acting is great. The comedy is also very good. The ending will have you in tears.

Ahmed helmy is a humorous actor but watching this move was so boring and has many repeated similar scenes. It revolves in a comedy framework, which exposes many of our impulses and egoism, as it shows our selfishness in our lived reality, ignoring others, from the people closest to us, such as our fathers and mothers to our neighbors and even the people we meet in the street, this movie shows the failure of self-seeking and its negative impact on our relationships.

Humorous, somehow also serious and it gives a lesson " don't be ruthless and think of your relatives and community as well"
